cell_overlap_rule: OSM polygon intersects WorldPop cell; rasterized with all_touched=True.
distance_rule: Distance from WorldPop cell centre to nearest OSM polygon, calculated in EPSG:3375 using OSM features from district + 250 m context.

support_class_rules.DIRECT_RESIDENTIAL: WorldPop cell intersects OSM landuse=residential or an explicitly residential building footprint.
support_class_rules.DIRECT_BUILT_CONTEXT: No direct residential overlap, but WorldPop cell intersects another OSM building footprint.
support_class_rules.NEAR_RESIDENTIAL_100M: No direct building overlap; nearest residential landuse/building evidence <=100 m.
support_class_rules.NEAR_BUILT_100M: No residential evidence <=100 m; nearest generic OSM building <=100 m.
support_class_rules.LIMITED_OSM_SUPPORT: No residential or generic-building evidence within 100 m under the above hierarchy.

worldpop_modification_policy: No WorldPop population value was deleted, moved, normalized, or reweighted in D05-B.
osm_interpretation_limit: Absence of an OSM building/residential polygon is not evidence of absence of population; OSM completeness is spatially heterogeneous.
